Messages.Author: tetragr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Some questions:
1. The text on Anson reads: "If Anson is ready,
you get 2 master phases actions (instead of 1)".
But what if i got a Rumors of Gehenna in play?
Do i get 3 master phases (Rumors + ready Anson)?
Or do i get only the additional master phase from Rumors? (Assuming
Anson gives me 2 master phases ONLY if i have no more than 1 master
phase).
If Anson's ability works with a Rumors of Gehenna (and with other cards
giving additionals master phases act)
then, Anson's text should read: "If Anson is ready, during your
master phase, you get an additional master phase action."
Is this correct?

2. A Malkavian can take an action via Madness Network
"after a Methuselah has finished all of his or her
minion phases action".
That means:
1. Malkavians can take actions when a given Methuselah's
has finished its minion phase. A Malkavian can act during influence
and discard phases.
2. Malkavians can take actions ONLY at the end of a given
Methuselah's
minion phase. A Malkavian cannot act during any of the following
phases (influence and discard).
I'm very unsure about that. If number 1 is correct, i have an
additional question:
A Malkavian takes a succesful inferior Revelation action (Sabbat, aus,
1 blood) during a Methuselah's discard phase.
Does that Methuselah burns 1 blood with a Camarilla Threat in play?

3. The bearer of Talbot's Chainsaw can self inflicts the 3 damage
during the Untap?
(I think yes, but need a rule.)
Is the Talbot a melee weapon?
(I think no, but maybe there's an errata somewhere).

Thanks in advance.
Aemilianus, Prince of Rome

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Some questions:
> 1. The text on Anson reads: "If Anson is ready,
> you get 2 master phases actions (instead of 1)".
> But what if i got a Rumors of Gehenna in play?
> Do i get 3 master phases (Rumors + ready Anson)?
> Or do i get only the additional master phase from Rumors? (Assuming
> Anson gives me 2 master phases ONLY if i have no more than 1 master
> phase).
> If Anson's ability works with a Rumors of Gehenna (and with other
cards
> giving additionals master phases act)
> then, Anson's text should read: "If Anson is ready, during your
> master phase, you get an additional master phase action."
> Is this correct?

Anson says you get 2, and Rumors says you get 2. So you get 2.
Neither of them say that they give you "additional" master phase
actions - just that you get 2.

> 2. A Malkavian can take an action via Madness Network
> "after a Methuselah has finished all of his or her
> minion phases action".
> That means:
> 1. Malkavians can take actions when a given Methuselah's
> has finished its minion phase. A Malkavian can act during influence
> and discard phases.
> 2. Malkavians can take actions ONLY at the end of a given
> Methuselah's
> minion phase. A Malkavian cannot act during any of the following
> phases (influence and discard).

2 is correct. The actions are taken during the minion phase.

> 3. The bearer of Talbot's Chainsaw can self inflicts the 3 damage
> during the Untap?
> (I think yes, but need a rule.)

Yes.

> Is the Talbot a melee weapon?
> (I think no, but maybe there's an errata somewhere).

No.
